connect_output: Note: every model the access point lists gets a route here. A call for any other model is offered to the plain backends of its API when your file has any, and to AIPlex backends only when it has none (Branchyard's rule for calls no route matches)
Note: branchyard.toml is edited as text: tables AIPlex does not write keep their comments and order; entries are added or replaced in place and never removed, so remove a stale route by hand

- export AIPLEX_TOKEN="$(aiplex auth print-token)"   # in the shell that runs `by`; Branchyard reads the variable named in [secrets]. The token expires: run it again to refresh (Branchyard reads the key when each turn's gateway starts)
- put branches on the model gateway: `by run --model-gateway ...`, or set `[models] allow = ["*"]` in branchyard.toml (not written: it decides which branches use it)
